resources.string: To use as an automatic screensaver:\n1. Open Screen Saver settings\n2. Select \'Table Clock\'
Learn how to set up automatic or manual activation
Choose how your clock comes to life.
Choose this app as your system screensaver to display the table clock when Android activates the screensaver.
On supported Samsung devices, use Modes and Routines to open the table clock automatically when you connect your charger.
Open Settings on your Samsung phone.
Select connecting a charger as the trigger, if available.
Add an action to open an app and select this table clock app.
Save the routine and test it.
Note: Menu names and available triggers may vary by device and One UI version.
Option 3: Automatically open when performing a certain gesture
On supported Samsung devices, use Modes and Routines to open the table clock automatically when you perform a certain side button press or finger swipe
Select a type of finger swipe or side button press as the trigger
Note: Menu names and available triggers may vary by device and One UI version.
